courses.name: Embedded Machine Learning
courses.summary: Hands-on GPIO, PWM and sensors on NUCLEO-F103RB boards, measurement with oscilloscopes and multimeters, and UART/RS-485 communication. After the embedded basics, students train a small model and port it to an STM32.

courses.name: Image Processing Programming
courses.summary: Practice-first course in Python and OpenCV, from basic image processing to Haar-like face detection and training deep learning models.

courses.name: Algorithms
courses.summary: Step-by-step practice in C, from finding a maximum and printing star patterns to the Tower of Hanoi.

talks.title: Designing and Building Embedded Systems with AI
talks.subtitle: Case study: TinyML lane detection on the ESP32-S3 edge

materials: Beginner Git/GitHub lecture series (version control, branching strategy, Linux GUI tools)
Korean translations of embedded textbooks (Barr-C coding standard, embedded C, STM32)
Interactive HTML learning materials on embedded systems fundamentals

projects.subtitle: TinyML edge lane detection on the ESP32-S3
projects.summary: A binary pixel-segmentation model trained on the TuSimple dataset, quantized from ONNX to ESP-DL INT8 and run in real time on an ESP32-S3. Used as the case study for a public lecture.

projects.subtitle: Drivable area estimation and lane-center guidance
projects.summary: Guides the vehicle along the drivable area and the line to follow, based on TwinLiteNet+. Currently validating with closed-loop driving in a Python simulator that rebuilds the Yongin driver's license test course.

projects.subtitle: Windows exam lockdown tool for class
projects.summary: A tool I built to block AI websites and programs during hands-on exams, used for midterms. Runs from the system tray and starts at boot.
